name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.13.0: Draw row markers as themed Material icons; Blend a chip's icon over the bar it sits on.
changelog.v2.12.2: Resolve a node's disc through the node, and never star ourselves.
changelog.v2.12.1: Drop a trailing slot that does not fit instead of drawing it.
changelog.v2.12.0: Add surface tiers, a shape scale and tonal accents to the theme; Keep the tab strip inside the panel at every glyph scale.
changelog.v2.11.0: Add a reusable card component and rebuild the Status tab on it; Clip a card's trailing note instead of dropping it whole.
